saved_filters
sql:
CREATE TABLE saved_filters (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

clips
sql:
CREATE TABLE "clips" (
    current_path TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    clip_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    file_size INTEGER NOT NULL,
    file_mtime REAL NOT NULL,
    rating INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    bpm REAL,
    mood TEXT,
    genre TEXT,
    energy INTEGER,
    brief TEXT,
    duration_sec REAL,
    dismissed_at REAL,
    created_at REAL NOT NULL,
    updated_at REAL NOT NULL,
    is_orphan INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
, frame_rate REAL, video_width INTEGER, video_height INTEGER)

name: text
clip_tags
sql:
CREATE TABLE "clip_tags" (
    current_path TEXT NOT NULL,
    tag TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (current_path, tag),
    FOREIGN KEY (current_path)
        REFERENCES clips(current_path)
        ON DELETE CASCADE
        ON UPDATE CASCADE
)

clip_search
sql:
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE clip_search USING fts5(
    current_path UNINDEXED,
    filename,
    tags,
    mood,
    genre,
    brief,
    tokenize = 'unicode61'
)
